name: agent_iee
_description: Fase B.3 plan Opus: Informe Evaluacion Edificios (Ley 8/2013 + RD 233/2013 Anexo II). Calificacion global A-G + recomendaciones priorizadas. Patron Draft/Commit. Lee executions previas de agent_accessibility y agent_energy_assessor si existen para mejorar normativa_confidence.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok)
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.project_type, p.location_province, p.location_city, p.location_address,
       p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency,
       p.metadata->>'notes' AS notes,
       (p.metadata->>'edad_edificio')::int AS edad_edificio_meta,
       (p.metadata->>'numero_plantas')::int AS numero_plantas_meta,
       (p.metadata->>'numero_viviendas')::int AS numero_viviendas_meta,
       p.metadata->>'tipologia_edificio' AS tipologia_meta,
       (SELECT output FROM agent_executions WHERE project_id = p.id AND agent_name = 'agent_accessibility' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS accesibilidad_output,
       (SELECT output FROM agent_executions WHERE project_id = p.id AND agent_name = 'agent_energy_assessor' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS energia_output
FROM projects p, ctx
WHERE p.id = $4::uuid LIMIT 1

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Decode JWT + Body').first().json.user_id, $('Decode JWT + Body').first().json.tenant_id, $('Decode JWT + Body').first().json.role, $('Decode JWT + Body').first().json.project_id] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_iee', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok)
INSERT INTO iee_reports_draft (
  project_id, tenant_id, estado_conservacion, condiciones_accesibilidad,
  eficiencia_energetica, calificacion_global, recomendaciones, draft_content, status
)
SELECT $4::uuid, $2::uuid, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb, 'draft' FROM ctx
RETURNING id, created_at

UPDATE agent_executions
SET status = 'completed',
    finished_at = now(),
    output = $2::jsonb,
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
